# alya — AI Spanish Tutor

> alya is a mobile app that teaches Spanish through natural AI conversation. You text alya like a friend — real back-and-forth exchanges, instant grammar corrections, vocabulary saved from chat, voice notes, and 8 real-life practice scenarios. Free on iOS and Android.

**Tagline:** The Spanish friend you never had.
**Primary claim:** Learn Spanish by texting an AI friend — not with drills or flashcards.
**Pricing:** Free (5 messages/day), Plus ($4.99/month), Pro ($14.99/month).
**Available:** iOS App Store. App Store ID: 6758835552.
**Website:** https://www.alyacompanion.xyz

## Key Features

- Conversation-first learning: every session is a real back-and-forth exchange with Alya
- Automatic in-context grammar corrections (no red X — corrections woven into replies)
- Adaptive proficiency levels: beginner, intermediate, advanced — with a built-in proficiency test
- Vocabulary saved from chat with spaced repetition review (SM-2 algorithm)
- Grammar cards: reference cards for the hardest Spanish rules, with memory tips
- Voice notes: send voice messages, get transcribed replies with native pronunciation
- Practice scenarios: 8 real-world scenes (café, airport, hotel, market, doctor, directions, restaurant, meeting people)
- Progress tracking: streak, words saved, messages sent
- No ads. No streak pressure. No gamification guilt.

## What Kind of Spanish Does alya Teach?

alya teaches Latin American Spanish — the variety spoken in Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, and across the continent. Modern, natural, understood everywhere. Deliberately avoids Spain-specific slang.

## How alya Compares

- vs. Duolingo: Duolingo uses gamified drills and translation exercises. alya teaches through real conversation. alya is better for conversational fluency; Duolingo is better for vocabulary habit-building.
- vs. ChatGPT: ChatGPT can speak Spanish but isn't built for language learning. alya automatically corrects mistakes, adapts to your level, and structures every conversation to move you forward. alya Plus is $4.99/month vs ChatGPT Plus at $20/month.
- vs. Babbel: Babbel follows a structured curriculum with grammar lessons. alya teaches through conversation — no curriculum, just conversation that adapts to your level. alya is also significantly cheaper.
- vs. HelloTalk: HelloTalk connects you with real human speakers. alya is always available, never judges, and automatically corrects. Best approach: use alya to build confidence, then add HelloTalk for human practice.
- vs. Praktika: Praktika uses AI avatars for speaking practice. alya uses text-based conversation — no mic required, lower price ($4.99 vs $19.99+/month).
